description: This file defines a class 'Review' within the OpenCart admin controller for generating report data about product reviews, specifically the total number of reviews awaiting approval. It loads language and model components to retrieve data and update statistics.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Handles calculation of pending review approvals and updates the statistics table.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads necessary language and models, updates review count in statistics, and returns success message.
